body:
The Clove Cough
I heard a story of my friend making a hash out of cloves so when I saw some I picked them up to try them out. I didn't have a grinder so I used pliers to break up and crush the cloves. I then rolled a little J that was 50/50 cloves and MJ.
Later after a couple of hours of working retail I was off and ready to relax a bit. I lit up my J, after the first few puffs I was enjoying the taste. It made my mouth go numb which was kinda cool. The smoke was harsh and only half was through I started to wish I used less clove. I got a head rush like I get from tobacco but it didn't last as long. I powered my way through the rest, that just got harsher and harsher. It was so harsh it hurt my nose when I was taking a hit, it was weird.
As after effects got the numb mouth about 15 minutes. It was nice like I had just had a really strong mint or Listerine. I wasn't loopy
, I was very relaxed, it definitely boosted the MJ a little.
It was a good experiment, but I probably wouldn't do it again alone, It was a little too much harsh smoke to power through alone.
All in all
Pros
-numb mouth
-flavorful
-burns well
Cons
-Harsh
-short lasting
-hurt my nose
